title: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
description: William Chapman was attacked by the tiger after he entered its pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.

title: One stolen every four minutes - inside the police battle against vehicle thieves
description: Officers tell the BBC they are overstretched and struggling to keep up with sophisticated criminals.

title: Watch: BBC joins police on front line against car theft
description: Investigations reporter NJ Convery has been out on a nighttime hunt for vehicle thieves.

title: Russian strikes leave 600,000 without power in Ukraine, Zelensky says
description: Ukraine's president says "critical" infrastructure was hit overnight, while emergency services say at least three were killed.

title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
description: Pope Leo had a "peaceful night" in the hospital after the surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican says.

title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
description: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

title: World's oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
description: Archaeologists say the wreck is up to 4,700 years old, dating to the Early Bronze Age.

title: Saudi Arabia overturns death sentence for man over Facebook comment, Sri Lanka says
description: Anojan Sivarasa's case sent shockwaves through Sri Lanka, spurring diplomatic efforts to seek clemency.

title: Hundreds of Royal Mail staff quitting each week under new efficiency plans
description: The CWU says more posties are leaving since a new delivery system was brought in that it claims is not working in hundreds of offices.
